senses.gloss: उध॑न् n. = ऊधन्, an udder, MaitrS. i, 3, 26

ऊ॑धस् m. n. (in Veda also) ऊ॑धन्, ऊ॑धर् (see Whitney's Gr. 430 b; in classical Sanskṛt the stem ऊधन् appears only in the fem. of an adj. compound, e.g. कुण्डोध्नी &c.) (√ वह् Comm. on Uṇ. iv, 192; √ उद्, T.) the udder of any female, breast, bosom, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
figuratively applied to the clouds, RV.
N. of a passage in the Mahānāmnī (q.v.) verses, Lāṭy.
ऊधस् [cf. Gk. οὖθαρ; Lat. ūber; Angl.Sax. ūder; Old High Germ. ūtar; Mod. Germ. Euter; Mod. Eng. udder; Gaël. uth.]
ऊधस्—वती f. (a female) with full udders, BhP.
ऊधन्य᳙ mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 1, 2) contained in or coming from the udder, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.
ऊधस्य mf(आ)n. milking, giving milk, Hcat.
